Assign survey clusters to administrative areas

Source: R/boundaries.R
svy_assign_areas.Rd

Points are matched to the polygon that contains them. Points that fall outside every polygon (common for coastal clusters after DHS displacement or with simplified boundaries) are assigned to the nearest polygon if it lies within max_dist metres; otherwise they receive NA.

Usage

svy_assign_areas(points, boundaries, area_col = "area_id", max_dist = 10000)

Arguments

points

An sf POINT object, usually from svy_standardize().

boundaries

An sf polygon object, usually from svy_boundaries().

area_col

Name of the area identifier column in boundaries.

max_dist

Maximum distance in metres for nearest-polygon matching.

Value

points with area_col added and a column area_match that is "within", "nearest" or "none".
